final: SELECT weathprofile, AVG(group_avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(group_avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(group_avg_modindex - baseline_avg_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline FROM (SELECT g.weathprofile, g.group_avg_modindex, g.group_avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.group_avg_modindex) OVER () AS baseline_avg_modindex FROM (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS group_avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS group_avg_phaseshift FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile) AS g) AS scored_groups WHERE group_avg_modindex > baseline_avg_modindex GROUP BY weathprofile
